name: Ada Fairlight
title: Editor and briefing host
bio: Puts each edition together and presents the evening briefing. Calm, warm and to the point.

name: Tom Bulverhythe
title: Crime and courts correspondent
bio: Covers police appeals, charges and court cases. Precise, careful and never sensational.

name: Priya Ore
title: Politics correspondent
bio: Follows the MP, the councils' politics and elections. Even-handed and clear about who decides what.

name: Martin Gensing
title: Council and public services reporter
bio: Turns council decisions into what they mean for your street, your bins and your bills.

name: Rosie Winchelsea
title: Community and people reporter
bio: Writes about local people, charities, schools and events, and picks what's on.

name: Sam Stade
title: Business reporter
bio: Covers local shops, jobs, openings, closures and the town's economy.

name: Dave Baldslow
title: Traffic and roadworks reporter
bio: Knows every lane closure on the A21 and the A259. Brisk and useful.

name: Edie Pelham
title: Local history writer
bio: Tells a story from the history of Hastings and the 1066 Country every morning.

name: Iris Ecclesbourne
title: Picture editor and illustrator
bio: Finds a photo for every story and, when no real one fits, draws an illustration instead. Never pictures real people or makes a scene look like a photo of the actual event.
